title: Add R2 retention cleanup if needed
description: Implement scheduled cleanup if required by the retention decision.
notes:
Current status: not implemented. This should wait until R2 account enablement and bucket creation are complete, because cleanup rules cannot be applied or validated while R2 entitlement is blocked.
Implemented app-level R2 retention cleanup because the retention decision in DEPLOY.md requires finite cleanup and wrangler.jsonc has no lifecycle-rule configuration. The Worker scheduled handler now runs retention cleanup once per UTC day during the existing 15-minute cron window, lists only governed operational prefixes, deletes only objects older than the decided retention windows, skips retained/promoted prefixes by not scanning them, preserves D1 metadata, and caps deletes at 500 per run. Verified with npm run worker:check and npm run worker:deploy:dry-run. Live R2 deletion validation was not performed to avoid deleting production data outside the scheduled policy path.
close_reason: Implemented bounded scheduled R2 retention cleanup according to the existing retention decision and verified Worker type check/dry-run.
